title: Cold rebuild: verify a signed webhook
summary: Rebuild VerifyWebhook from memory, no hints.

steps.title: Cold rebuild
body: You wrote **VerifyWebhook** in *Threat model a feature: partner webhooks*. Write it again from an **empty editor**.
The tests are the ones you passed: tampering, replays, a future timestamp, key rotation and malformed headers.
If you get stuck, go back to the lesson and try again tomorrow. This check, plus the boss, proves the module.

steps.prompt: Why is the timestamp part of the signed text, not only a separate header?
options: Otherwise an attacker replays an old signed body with a fresh timestamp header
It does not need to be

steps.title: Rebuild VerifyWebhook cold
prompt: Write `bool VerifyWebhook(string body, string? signature, string? timestamp, byte[] secret, DateTimeOffset now)`: Unix-seconds timestamp within 300 s of `now`; any comma-separated `v1=<hex>` entry equal to HMAC-SHA256(secret, `timestamp.body`), compared in constant time. `using System.Security.Cryptography;`.
